title: Money-back guarantee, branding, and privacy statement as trust signals
statement:
An experiment on Internet commerce found that an unconditional money-back guarantee, branding, and a privacy statement could each function as trust signals, allowing landing pages to combine financial protection, familiar identity, and information privacy cues. (Macquarie University)

Options:
- Money-back guarantee: unconditional-money-back-guarantee (fits: risk reducing, trial friendly, new customer)
- Brand signal: brand-recognition-block (fits: familiar, premium, identity led)
- Privacy statement: privacy-statement-near-form (fits: data sensitive, transparent, form heavy)
- Combined trust row: combined-trust-signal-row (fits: compact, high consideration, evidence led)
appliesWhen: Applies to: ecommerce, online retail, new brands, high uncertainty purchases. Audience: adults, general.

source.title: Lemons on the Web: A signalling approach to the problem of trust in Internet commerce
source.authors: Boon Chye Lee; Lawrence Ang; Chris Dubelaar
